plain: Not open or honest; unfair and sly in manner.

webster.text: Unfair; not open, frank and candid; meanly artful; illiberal; applied to persons.

more.text: Unfair; meanly artful; unbecoming true honor and dignity; as disingenuous conduct; disingenuous schemes.

example.quote: The disingenuous form in which this objection is usually stated has been repeatedly adverted to and exposed, but continues to be pursued in all the conversations and writings of the opponents of the plan.
